title: Broken Adaptive Ridge in High-Dimensional Vector Autoregressions
abstract: arXiv:2611.18227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study regularized estimation in high-dimensional vector autoregressions under physical dependence and row-wise approximate sparsity using the Broken Adaptive Ridge (BAR) estimator. BAR is an iteratively reweighted Ridge procedure whose fixed-point first-order conditions imply a coordinatewise thresholding rule that produces exact zeros. We show that the BAR estimation error can be analyzed on the union of the population support above the BAR threshold and the support selected in the sample. The size of this union can be controlled at the rate implied by approximate sparsity, allowing us to establish the required restricted-curvature condition and derive L1, L2, and prediction error rates when the number of regressors grows polynomially with the sample size and may exceed it. translated_title: 高维向量自回归中的断裂自适应岭回归估计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在高维向量自回归模型中，于物理相依性和逐行近似稀疏性条件下，使用断裂自适应岭回归估计器进行正则化估计的方法。BAR 是一种迭代加权的岭回归过程，其不动点的一阶条件蕴含一种逐坐标阈值化规则，从而能够产生精确的零值估计。我们证明了 BAR 的估计误差可以在“总体支撑集中高于 BAR 阈值的部分”与“样本中筛选出的支撑集”的并集上进行分析。该并集的规模可以按近似稀疏性所隐含的速率加以控制，这使我们能够建立所需的受限曲率条件，并在回归变量数量随样本量多项式增长且可能超过样本量的情况下，推导出 L1、L2 以及预测误差的收敛速率。在精确稀疏性的情形下，所得速率恢复出稀疏高维估计中熟知的经典速率。蒙特卡洛实验在多种高维情形下……
tldr: 本文提出在高维向量自回归模型中使用断裂自适应岭回归（BAR）估计器，在物理相依与近似稀疏条件下建立了 L1、L2 和预测误差的收敛速率理论，且允许回归变量数量超过样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes L1, L2, and prediction error rates for the Broken Adaptive Ridge estimator in high-dimensional vector autoregressions under physical dependence and approximate sparsity, allowing the number of regressors to grow polynomially with—and even exceed—the sample size.
